verdict.rationale: Sierra lets users define step-by-step agent workflows (customer journeys) that the deployed agent runs on its own across channels. Explorer also delivers a weekly briefing automatically, without being asked. However, these workflows run in response to customer conversations, and the weekly briefing is a fixed built-in feature rather than something users configure. missing for 10: user-configurable scheduled or event-triggered background automations, documentation of unattended job execution outside live conversations, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Define step-by-step workflows for your agent from scratch, or use AI to instantly generate journeys from your existing operating procedures.
Explorer automatically delivers a weekly briefing on key trends, emerging issues, and recommendations — without you having to ask.
add a UI, describe how the agent can work with it, and get the agent set up and working.
